summary: One church. The newest bulletin (Nov 15) has a feast-day cover with no schedule box, so the Masses rest on its intentions and priest schedule plus the Nov 8 Liturgy Schedule box and the website, which all agree (Sunday 8:15 AM despite intentions saying 8:00; Confession Sat 4:00-4:45). Weekday 12:05 Mass is off Memorial Day-Labor Day, given a conservative Sept 8-May 24 season. Open: Monday Exposition after the 8 AM Mass, and the hours of First Friday Nocturnal Adoration, where three parish sources disagree.

slots.rationale: R1, R35, POLICY Weekly qualifiers (season): the newest intentions list a 12:05pm Mass every weekday; the Nov 8 box says only 8:00 am from Memorial Day to Labor Day. Those holidays move, so per R33 the season is the part of the year always outside that summer: Sept 8 (Labor Day is Sept 1-7) to May 24 (Memorial Day is May 25-31). A few days around the holidays are left out rather than shown wrongly.

sources.said: Exposition Mondays following the 8:00 am Mass

slots.rationale: R29: only the Nov 8 bulletin's masthead prints it; the newest issue has a feast-day cover and no schedule box, so it neither confirms nor contradicts it. Only one older week read, so R36 can't apply. The website's Adoration section names only First Friday (a missing mention is not a conflict, R6). Leaning include at 8:30 AM per R10 (30 minutes after a weekday Mass), since the box is one week old.
